an3.131:1.1: tīṇimāni bhikkhave, paṭicchannāni vahanti no vivaṭāni.
an3.131:1.3: mātugāmo bhikkhave, paṭicchanno vahati, no vivaṭo.
an3.131:1.4: brāhmaṇānaṃ bhikkhave, mantā paṭicchannā vahanti, no vivaṭā.
an3.131:1.5: micchādiṭṭhi bhikkhave, paṭicchannā vahati, no vivaṭā.
an3.131:1.6: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi paṭicchannāni vahanti, no vivaṭāni.
an3.131:2.1: tīṇimāni bhikkhave, vivaṭāni virocanti, no paṭicchannāni.
an3.131:2.3: candamaṇḍalaṃ bhikkhave, vivaṭaṃ virocati, no paṭicchannaṃ.
an3.131:2.4: sūriyamaṇḍalaṃ bhikkhave, vivaṭaṃ virocati, no paṭicchannaṃ.
an3.131:2.5: tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo, bhikkhave, vivaṭo virocati, no paṭicchanno.
an3.131:2.6: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi vivaṭāni virocanti, no paṭicchannānīti.
